title: Sword of Clutching Umbra

sources.title: Shadowsoaked Blow
markers: | description = Strike an enemy, adding your [[proficiency bonus]] to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional {{DamageText|1d6|Psychic|drs=t}} damage. This attack doesn't break concealment.

summary: +1 shortsword with a concealment-preserving weapon action.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial, One-handed, 5 ft melee, Finesse, Light. 1d6 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Shadowsoaked Blow: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee weapon attack adds proficiency bonus Piercing and 1d6 Psychic on hit. Keeps Hidden but ends Invisibility. The Psychic rider can act as a damage source even in Honour Mode.
fields.Flourish: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Bonus Action, 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns, granting attackers Advantage and giving the target Disadvantage on STR/DEX checks. Damage or Help clears it.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon damage. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Successful hits gain 2 Piercing. Honour Mode adds 2 of the original type to any damage source. Healing clears it. Undead and Constructs are immune.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
